title: Melanau language
text: The Melanau language is a dialect cluster within the Austronesian language family, spoken primarily by the Melanau ethnic group along the coastal and swampy regions of central Sarawak in Malaysian Borneo, from the Balingian River in the north to the Rajang River delta in the south.
